fields.features:
THE DRILL — Sleeping Soldiers train. You begin every session with a list of four Drills actions you have practiced into reflex. The list is recorded on your character sheet at character creation, and grows with downtime; example Drills include cover fire, breach maneuver, controlled retreat, weapon swap. When you take an action that matches a Drill, you may, once per Drill per encounter, resolve the action without rolling, it succeeds at standard parameters. Drills cover routine, practiced actions under ordinary conditions, not decisive blows or actions taken under extreme pressure; those you roll for. Drills handle the routine cases; Effort handles the rest.

RESOLVE MOVES
Universal · Bear Down: Spend and roll, any number. After any Duality Roll, attack, reaction, or damage roll, before the outcome is narrated, spend Resolve Dice and add their total. The plainest refusal to fail.
Soldier · Take the Hit: Spend and roll 1+. When an ally in Close range is hit, intercept: reduce the blow by the rolled total and take what remains yourself.
Soldier · Disciplined Strike: Spend and roll 1+. Add the rolled total to a damage roll; if it pushes the hit up a threshold band, it lands in the higher band.
Peacekeeper · Stand Down: Spend and roll 1+. Add the rolled total to a roll to disarm, restrain, or de-escalate without killing. Word spreads that you ended it without blood.
fields.a_feattext: Spend 2 Hope after a successful hit to deal +1d6 damage and push the fight in your favor.
fields.s_feattext: You can spend 2 Effort to deal an additional 1d6 damage when you successfully hit with an attack. This is the smallest Effort cost of any Sleeping Class Feature; the Soldier's signature is meant to be used often, not saved for capstone moments. Discipline is small, and constant.
